title: Iridescent Melting Gate
description: A surreal ornate gate with intricate purple metalwork stands in the center, covered in dripping, melting iridescent blue and turquoise liquid that forms long icicle-like drips. A glowing golden crescent moon and a faint horse-like figure swirl in the bright, hazy background amid sparkling light particles and soft rays.
prompt: A surreal ornate purple metal gate with intricate scrollwork is melting and dripping with thick iridescent blue and turquoise liquid forming long crystalline drips and icicles. A glowing golden crescent moon and a faint ethereal horse swirl in the bright hazy background. Soft light rays, sparkling golden particles, and delicate bubbles fill the atmosphere, ethereal and dreamlike fantasy painting.
